lead.headline: Why Artificial Intelligence Has Not Killed Mathematics ?

articles.headline: Why Artificial Intelligence Has Not Killed Mathematics ?
AI's 'mathocalypse': Is artificial intelligence ending the era of human mathematics?
articles.snippet: AI's rapid advances in solving longstanding mathematical problems have sparked fears of a 'mathocalypse', raising questions about the future of human mathematicians and research careers. But experts…

briefing.summary: Recent progress by artificial intelligence in addressing enduring mathematical challenges has raised concerns about the future of research careers. Despite anxieties regarding human obsolescence, discussions indicate that these technological developments have not brought an end to mathematics.
briefing.whyItMatters: Rapid progress in solving longstanding mathematical problems illustrates significant advancements in automated problem-solving for artificial intelligence researchers.
